name: Company primary SIEM (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch _search or Splunk saved searches, read-only)
operator: The organisation running V3LUM (module setting siem_url)
tier_rationale: The team's own primary SIEM operated by the company or a contracted processor (A12: disclosure 'internal', allowed at TLP:RED); community or shared platforms must be registered as third-party providers instead.

reliability.justification: The organisation's own telemetry (proxy, DNS, EDR, mail logs): exact term matches over a bounded window; counts are facts about our logs, not verdicts about the value.

siem.description: read-only service-account token of the primary SIEM (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch API key or bearer token, Splunk authentication token)
siem.plan_hint: a read-only least-privilege service account limited to the SOC-approved index patterns / saved searches (A12)

search.title: SIEM look-back through SOC-approved, versioned templates (term/terms _search or saved-search dispatch; counts and first/last seen only)

terms.quote: disclosure='internal' (allowed at TLP:RED) applies only to instances operated by the company or a contracted processor.

search.notes: Own data through a read-only service account (research C0736). Quote: binding council text (A12). Personal identifiers (e-mail, username, user agent) are searched only inside a case with a recorded incident purpose and ticket, under the company's monitoring policy and privacy notice (P349 C6); results follow the case retention and are never used for HR or performance purposes.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G07-2 (P349 siem_search). Disabled unless setting siem_url (https), key 'siem' and the SOC-approved template file (setting siem_search_templates) are configured; read-only endpoints only (POST <patterns>/_search with size 0, saved-search dispatch with trigger_actions=0, job status and results GETs), TLS verification always on (setting ca_bundle, A12). One query at a time (concurrency 1) and never cached (ttl 0: counts change and personal-identifier queries never reach http_cache.db).
